import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'chinstrap': 'Chinstrap'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Convert text-stored numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    # Fix out-of-range body_mass_g (e.g., 3650000 is clearly erroneous)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] > 6500) | (df['body_mass_g'] < 2500), 'body_mass_g'] = None
    return df

def answer(df):
    counts = df.groupby('island').size()
    return counts.to_dict()
